_meta.title: FLUX.3 Klein I2I
_meta.description: FLUX.3 Klein img2img: LoadImage -> VAEEncode -> KSampler (denoise 0.6) -> VAEDecode. Not an official template (the official edit path is ReferenceMultiLatent, see edit.json); uses the base t2i sampler settings: 50 steps, CFG 3.5, euler/simple. REQUIRES (gated, accept the BFL license on HF first): black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy diffusion_models/flux3-image-klein-base-bf16.safetensors (the base checkpoint), saved as diffusion_models/flux3_image_klein_bf16.safetensors, plus text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors (CLIP type flux3) and vae/flux2-vae.safetensors from the same repo. bf16 on Apple Silicon (int8_convrot/nvfp4 are CUDA paths). The official template runs the Qwen3.5 9B prompt upsampler first; this graph skips it, so write a full scene caption (subject, framing, background, lighting).
